description: React component for an emoji picker with AI integration, including UI elements, emoji selection, and AI-based emoji suggestion features.

methods.name: getFrequentlyUsedEmojis
methods.description: Retrieves the most frequently used emojis from local storage, sorted by usage count.

methods.name: useAI
methods.description: Uses AI to generate a single emoji that best represents a task, with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: emojiToUnified
methods.description: Converts an emoji character into its unified code string.

methods.name: renderAvatarContent
methods.description: Renders the emoji avatar content, showing either a loading spinner, the selected emoji, or a default icon.
